=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml: lines 578-589 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new "Pre-assemble static context" reader inlines `agents.md` only when the lowercase file exists. A repo whose agents file is `AGENTS.md` falls through every branch — `[ -f agents.md ]` is false, `[ -L agents.md ]` is false — so the entire `=== AGENTS.MD ===` section is silently omitted, with no warning emitted.
  WHY: In any future state where coding-workflows (or a repo that runs an equivalent of this step) ships with `AGENTS.md` instead of `agents.md`, the orchestrator model receives no agents context at all — not the bare file and not pending fragments. The README contract at lines 1207-1209 explicitly lists "the orchestrate, clarify-respond, poller-judge and validate static-context assemblers" as the five reader sites that must render pending fragments, so dropping one breaks the documented contract. It is not just a future-proofing concern: the symlink-warning block (`elif [ -L agents.md ]`) is now unreachable for `AGENTS.md`-only repos, hiding the same warning path the other three sites also add for `AGENTS.md` (orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml lines 733-738).
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml: line 582 (and the analogous lines 749 in orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml, 1365 in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, 3090 in scripts/validate_process.sh) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The render branch uses `printf '%s\n' "${captured}"` to emit the assembled agents text, but the command substitution `$()` strips every trailing newline from the captured output and `printf '%s\n'` then unconditionally appends one. The `cat` fallback on the matching `else` arm preserves the file's actual trailing-newline state.
  WHY: For the file state used in practice the output is byte-identical. The defect only manifests if a future change writes the agents file without a trailing newline, in which case the render branch produces one extra blank line versus the cat branch. The drift is consistent across all four sites, so it is not a regression introduced by LAST RUN DIFF — the prior editor round rejected a different concern in the same area — but it remains a known formatting inconsistency between the two arms of every new reader site.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Readers see pending fragments: `scripts/build_static_context.sh` and the orchestrate, clarify-respond, poller-judge and validate static-context assemblers render them into the model's agents context (falling back to the plain file)" (README.md lines 1207-1209), and the parallel contract in CLAUDE.md §30 that the consumers' agents file may be `AGENTS.md`.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml step "Pre-assemble static context" (lines 578-589).
  Evidence of absence: The LAST RUN DIFF added the render-with-fallback for `agents.md` but did not add the two-stage "AGENTS.md first, agents.md fallback" selection the three companion sites introduced (orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml lines 739-744, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 1355-1360, scripts/validate_process.sh lines 3080-3085). As a result the orchestrator reader drops the `=== AGENTS.MD ===` section silently for any consumer using the documented `AGENTS.md` casing, in violation of the reader contract the README just stated.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
